name: Texas UIL State Cross Country Championships
where: Round Rock, TX · Old Settlers Park
headline: Texas UIL State Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 6 El Paso Eastwood (56) beats No. 3 Southlake Carroll (68) for the 6A boys title; Ruel Newberry (Denton Guyer) wins in 14:36.3; Flower Mound wins 6A girls (68).
